signal: Bitsight was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave Cybersecurity Risk Ratings Q2 2026 and a Visionary in Gartner's 2026 Cyber Threat Intelligence Magic Quadrant.

email.body1:
Mariah, saw Bitsight was just named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for risk ratings.

Analyst wins like that drive a wave of in-market accounts, more than reps can personally research and follow up on, so good leads slip while you write. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up, so you spend time in conversations instead: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of Bitsight's top accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Mariah, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

As an SDR riding analyst momentum, the bottleneck is usually follow-up volume and response speed, not effort. There are more accounts than hours, and deep research is exactly what eats the day.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. I'll bring specifics for Bitsight.
email.body3:
Mariah, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight's reply rate likely compares to other security teams. Want to grab time and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mariah, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If getting more capacity on your accounts without more headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Riding an analyst win, I know your week is plenty full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a security SDR motion? I'll tailor it to Bitsight either way.
